name: app-user-guide-generator-marketplace
description: Marketplace for the App User Guide Generator plugin — generate end-user guides for any app module from its own in-app help content (verbatim) or, as a fallback, from source code investigation.

plugins.name: app-user-guide-generator
plugins.description: Generate end-user guides per module — finds and extracts the app's own existing help content verbatim before ever reconstructing one from reading code.
